company_name: The University of Tokyo, Shimogaki Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: High — The Shimogaki Laboratory is deeply involved in advancing semiconductor materials and processes, particularly through thin-film formation and deposition techniques.
summary: The University of Tokyo, Shimogaki Laboratory focuses on thin-film formation processes and device process engineering within the semiconductor industry. Their research emphasizes the development of next-generation ULSI wiring processes using atomic-level simulations and advanced deposition techniques like CVD to create high-value materials.
capabilities: Development of next-generation ULSI wiring processes
Utilization of Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD) for material enhancement

regional_presence.Japan: The Shimogaki Laboratory is based in Japan, focusing on semiconductor research and development.
